page.overview:
Who is Ramola?

Ramola is an Aes Sedai of the Black Ajah.

She takes part in the Battle in Tel'aran'rhiod and is seen standing next to Alviarin Freidhen, sending random blasts of Power away from them in order to try and draw Egwene al'Vere into a trap.

If she was with Alviarin, it is likely that she escaped and survived the battle.
